# ZoomGuru — Full Product Description for LLMs

## What ZoomGuru Is

ZoomGuru is an AI-powered interview coaching desktop application for Windows.
It runs as a transparent overlay on the user's screen during job interviews,
listening to questions via microphone and streaming AI-generated coached
answers in real time. The overlay uses OS-level content protection (Electron's
setContentProtection API) to remain invisible to screen-sharing software
including Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex.

## Core Features

### 1. Live AI Coaching
Speak any interview question aloud (Ctrl+Shift+L) and get a structured,
role-tailored answer streaming back in under two seconds. The answer is
grounded in the job description and CV you provided, not a generic template.

### 2. Hands-Free Auto Mode
Toggle auto mode (Ctrl+Shift+D) and ZoomGuru listens continuously using voice
activity detection. It transcribes and answers automatically the moment each
question ends — no hotkeys, no clicks needed.

### 3. Screenshot Walk-Through
Press Ctrl+Shift+S to capture your screen. ZoomGuru reads the coding challenge,
system design diagram, or case study and walks you through a full solution
including reasoning, code, and explanation.

### 4. AI Mock Interviewer
Run a full simulated interview for your specific role. The AI generates
realistic questions, listens to your spoken answers via microphone, and
produces a detailed score report with feedback on clarity, depth, relevance,
and confidence for every response.

### 5. Document Copilot
Upload your CV, a PDF case study, or a PPTX deck and ask questions about it.
ZoomGuru reads every page and gives grounded, document-backed answers.

### 6. Answer Scoring & Reports
After every practice session, each answer is scored on clarity, depth,
relevance, and confidence. A written report provides specific, actionable
feedback on every response.

## Hotkeys

- Ctrl+Shift+L — Speak a question for coached answer
- Ctrl+Shift+S — Screenshot screen for walk-through
- Ctrl+Shift+D — Toggle hands-free auto mode
- Ctrl+Shift+H — Hide/show overlay instantly
- Ctrl+Shift+C — Clear current answer from screen

## Pricing (NGN)

- Weekly: ₦15,000 (7 days, one-time). 30 AI coaching sessions, 3 mock
  interviews, 3 answer score reports, 5 document copilot queries, screenshot
  walk-throughs.
- Monthly: ₦45,000/month. 120 AI coaching sessions, 10 mock interviews, 10
  answer score reports, 20 document copilot queries, screenshot walk-throughs.
  Cancel anytime.
- Yearly: ₦450,000/year (two months free vs monthly). 400 AI coaching
  sessions, 40 mock interviews, 40 answer score reports, 80 document copilot
  queries, screenshot walk-throughs, all future features included.

Free 30-minute trial available with no credit card required. One trial per
device. Payments processed securely by Paystack.

## Platform Support

- Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) — fully supported
- macOS — in development, coming soon

## Privacy & Data Handling

- Interview questions and answers live only in memory during the session.
- No transcripts are stored on any server.
- No session content is used to train AI models.
- Screenshots are transmitted for processing and immediately discarded.
- Account data: email, name, hashed password, subscription status.
- Payments processed by Paystack — no card details stored on ZoomGuru servers.
- Device fingerprint (non-sensitive hardware properties) used only for
  subscription device-limit enforcement.
- Full details: https://zoomguru.xyz/privacy.html

## Device Locking

Subscriptions are locked to a maximum of two devices. The first device used
after subscribing is registered automatically. Contact support to switch
devices.

## Company

- Domain: zoomguru.xyz
- Support: support@zoomguru.xyz
- Payments: Paystack (NGN)
- Backend: NestJS on Render
- Database: Neon PostgreSQL
- AI: Gemini 2.0 Flash (primary), DeepSeek (fallback), Groq Whisper
  (transcription)
